children: China's investment in artificial intelligence is set to continue to increase, says BofA Securities, forecasting the country's AI capital expenditure to rise from $110 billion in 2025 to $350 billion in 2030. Total capital expenditure over the course of China's 15th five-year plan could reach $1.4 trillion, funded by internet firms, telecoms and government support, BofA says. China has several advantages in the global AI build-out, including its dominant role in AI materials, ample power, as well as a younger grid, which is below 20 years old, compared with older grids in the U.S. and Europe, BofA says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
